explanation: The proof relies on the library's own CommHopfAlgCat.derivedDefiningIdeal_eq_bot_iff_forall_hom_eq_unit_comp_counit, which is in TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Derived/Perfect.lean. It also uses the library's own coordinateHopfAlgebra and derivedDefiningIdeal_eq_bot. Mathlib has no `derivedDefiningIdeal`. In Mathlib, `unitBialgHom` composed with `counitBialgHom` appears only as the definition of `1` on convolution (Bialgebra/Convolution.lean). `CommHopfAlgCat` appears only in Algebra/Category/CommHopfAlgCat.lean and AlgebraicGeometry/Group/Affine.lean. I found no Mathlib statement that every morphism from a cocommutative Hopf algebra to the SL_n coordinate Hopf algebra is trivial.
